config.baseline_authority: User: 90% LTV, 4% interest, 35 years, management-fee coverage, preferred 6% gross yield
config.other_parameters_authority: Inherited synthetic comparison assumptions; not user finances, legal cost quotations or approved return targets
config.cost_boundary: Fee input is a combined service/sinking proxy; other cost is an allowance. Base figures are pre-tax and omit unquoted transaction-specific costs. Unknown costs are not verified zero.

limitations: Pre-tax conditional arithmetic; no family/management premium, actual costs or achieved rent authenticated. Unknown costs not zero. 8% hurdle illustrative.

retention_tradeoff.meaning: Contractual RM2300 versus RM2400 for 24 paid months costs RM2400; one otherwise lost RM2400 month offsets it before fees/defaults. This is arithmetic, not observed retention or 24-month payment assurance.

checks.financial_identities: closed amortisation, principal conservation, independent interest-cost exit identity and discounted hurdle passed
